endgames.title: Queen mate
endgames.idea: Box the king in with your queen a knight's jump away, bring your king up, then mate on the edge.

endgames.title: Rook mate
endgames.idea: Cut the king off with the rook, walk your king opposite theirs, and push them back one rank at a time.

endgames.title: King in front of the pawn
endgames.idea: Your king leads, the pawn follows. Take the opposition so their king has to step aside.

endgames.title: Two bishops mate
endgames.idea: Side by side, the bishops make a wall. Shrink the box toward a corner and bring the king.

endgames.title: The opposition
endgames.idea: Get your king in front of the pawn first. Then win the opposition before pushing.

endgames.title: Lucena position
endgames.idea: Build a bridge: bring your rook to the fourth rank so it can block checks later.

endgames.title: Philidor defence
endgames.idea: Keep your rook on the sixth rank. When the pawn steps up, check from behind.

endgames.title: Queen against rook
endgames.idea: Drive the king and rook to the edge together, then win the rook with a fork or a skewer.

endgames.title: Bishop and knight mate
endgames.idea: Mate only comes in a corner your bishop covers. Use the W-manoeuvre with the knight.

endgames.title: Rook against bishop
endgames.idea: Defend: keep your king in the corner that's the opposite colour of your bishop.
